entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: Human wizard and Oracle of Arcavios, the wisest and most powerful mage on the plane, who specialized in substance manipulation.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane of which Jadzi was Oracle.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: Archaic that abducted Jadzi and took her to a chamber beneath Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Souls of dead oracles that return to the origin of Arcavios.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker whose attempt to kill the Dawning Archaic disrupted Jadzi's ritual.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: Quandrix mage-student who pushed Jadzi into the nexus.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: Echoverse figure who imprisoned Jadzi to enable his plan to overlay the Echoverse onto the Multiverse.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: Place where Jadzi was imprisoned in Hexhaven.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: Place in the Echoverse where Jadzi was imprisoned.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: Site above the chamber containing a nexus of wild energy.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion whose damage Jadzi spent time repairing.

events.summary: Jadzi is abducted by the Dawning Archaic and brought beneath Titan's Grave.
events.quote: During the fall semester of 4565, she was abducted by the Dawning Archaic

events.summary: Chandra disrupts Jadzi's ritual and Tamira pushes her into the nexus, making her disappear from reality.
events.quote: causing her to disappear from reality

events.summary: Jadzi arrives in Hexhaven and is imprisoned by the Theorist.
The Theorist cannot bring himself to kill Jadzi, who studies and taunts him.
events.quote: The Theorist repeatedly visited Jadzi's cell, but could never work up the nerve to kill her.

events.summary: Jadzi grabs the Theorist's knife and kills herself, allowing him to witness the birth of Arcavios.
events.quote: she grabbed his knife and used it to kill herself

relations.quote: Jadzi had to be killed to make this possible.
she was abducted by the Dawning Archaic
the Quandrix mage-student Tamira pushed her into the nexus
